title: Pokus installer answers
description: Every non-secret choice of the installer TUI (BUILD_PROMPT §18.6), replayed with bootstrap.sh --answers. Records which secrets are generated and which are provided, never their values. Cross-field rules that JSON Schema cannot express (the device confirmation, disjoint cpusets, unique researchers, at least one admin) are checked by pokus_installer.answers.

mode.description: fresh: a new lab; restore: provision, then restore a snapshot; modify: change an installed lab.

name.description: Machine name: host_vars file, tailnet host name, fingerprints.

lab_mode.description: production, or staging: a QA lab with its own vault, research space and Tailscale identity (tag:pokus-qa) that never pairs with production.

node_role.description: full: everything on this host; lab: lab services, inference on a paired node; inference: vLLM only (docs/node-roles.md).

provider.description: auto takes the provider from the host profile.

power_policy.description: lab_session_inhibit keeps the host awake while a lab session runs; never_sleep; os_default (always on WSL, where Windows decides).

firewall_backend.description: auto takes the host's active firewall (nftables, firewalld or ufw).

allow_community_repos.description: Allow community package repositories where a component has no official one (the component source matrix).

machine.description: The host: name, role, provider and paths.

expected_memory_gib.description: Memory the host should have (on WSL: memory= of .wslconfig); doctor warns when it differs.

expected_cpu_threads.description: CPU threads the host should have (on WSL: processors= of .wslconfig).

cpuset_services.description: CPUs of the lab services (Linux cpuset list, such as 0-5).

cpuset_targets.description: CPUs of the Incus targets; must not overlap cpuset_services.

postgres_shared_buffers.description: Postgres shared_buffers, such as 2048MB; empty derives it from the memory.

resources.description: Expected resources and the CPU split between lab services and targets.

source.description: loop: a loop file inside the system; device: a dedicated disk, formatted.

loop_size_gib.description: Size of the loop file (source loop), at least 20 GiB.

device.description: The pool disk by its /dev/disk/by-id path (source device).

device_confirm.description: Must equal device exactly; the pool disk is formatted only then (safety invariant 1).

force_wipe.description: Wipe a device that carries signatures (typed WIPE confirmation in the TUI).

storage.description: The Incus storage pool of the targets.

admin.description: Member of pokus-admin (sudo on the host); at least one researcher is an admin.

grafana.description: Create a Grafana account (password generated into the vault).

researchers.description: The lab's researchers: Linux accounts, research space directories, Grafana accounts.

researchers_removed.description: Researchers who left: their accounts are locked, their data stays.

tailscale_tag.description: The node's tailnet tag; empty: tag:pokus-lab, or tag:pokus-qa on staging.

tailscale_login.description: auth_key: from POKUS_SECRET_TAILSCALE_AUTHKEY or the TUI; interactive: the login URL is shown during the install.

grafana_tailscale_serve.description: Publish Grafana on the tailnet with tailscale serve (never Funnel).

ssh_extra_allowed_interfaces.description: Network interfaces besides tailscale0 that accept SSH (not on WSL).

split_inference.description: For node_role lab or inference: the machine name of the other node once paired (docs/node-roles.md); pairing can also come later (pokus-lab pair).

peer.description: Machine name of the paired node.

install_driver.description: install_nvidia_driver: auto (the pinned branch of versions.lock.yml), manual or skip.

accept_mok_enrollment.description: Consent that bootstrap installs the NVIDIA driver and imports a Machine Owner Key on a Secure Boot host (install_driver auto only; approved deviation I1). Bootstrap reads the one-time MOK password from standard input (--mok-password-stdin); this file never holds it.

vllm_profile.description: A profile of vllm/profiles/; empty: chosen from the GPU.

default_model.description: An id of models.lock.yml, or none (vLLM installed, nothing served).

start_serving.description: Start serving the default model after the install.

gpu.description: NVIDIA driver, vLLM serving profile and default model.

repository.description: The restic repository by type: sftp (host, user, path), rest (url), local (path; not a real backup) or later (doctor warns until it is set).

password.description: The restic password: generated (shown once) or provided (POKUS_SECRET_RESTIC_PASSWORD).

include_models.description: Back up model weights too (large; they can be downloaded again).

source.description: The Pokus repository that platform and catalog are deployed from (owner answer E3).

repo.description: An SSH URL (read with a deploy key generated on the host) or an anonymous https URL.

known_hosts.description: Host key lines of an SSH source other than GitHub.

require_signed_tags.description: Deploy only tags signed by an allowed signer.

allowed_signers.description: allowed_signers lines (ssh-keygen -Y) of the tag signers.

generate.description: Service passwords (database roles, Grafana users) are always generated.

hf_token.description: provided (POKUS_SECRET_HF_TOKEN) for gated models, else none.

store_vault_password.description: Keep the vault password root-only in /etc/pokus/secrets/vault-pass.

secrets.description: Which secrets are generated and which are provided (never their values).

hostname.description: Host name: lower-case letters, digits and '-', at most 63 characters.

username.description: Linux user name: lower-case, starting with a letter, not reserved, not pokus-*.

username_any.description: A Linux user name (also one already removed).

cpuset.description: A Linux cpuset list, such as 0-5,8.

ref.description: Tag (recommended: platform-v*/catalog-v*), branch or full commit to deploy.
